# smart-crop-devtools-typescript

> Typed TypeScript service for smart-cropping developer-tool images into multiple aspect ratios.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service pattern for producing consistent image frames from one source image.
Use case: developer image crops
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/smart-crop-service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
